product.name: Monoprice 4-Port USB 2.0 HUB
product.description: The 4-port USB 2.0 hub provides 4 Hi-Speed USB 2.0 ports for your high-speed connectivity needs. This device is USB 2.0 and provides a data transfer rate of up to 480 Mbps (high speed). Also supports USB 1.1 devices since it is backward compatible with USB 1.1 specifications.
